claim: Measure whether unchanged Timeline IR expresses each of the remaining 72 in-scope external requests under recorded precedent-based interpretations.
why_it_matters: Removes selective depth-subset coverage as the reason most screened requests were never encoded.
minimum_convincing_evidence: 72 distinct source-linked records; frozen interpretations and expected traces; actual reference execution or documented support failures; retained limitations.
anti_claim: All possible operator combinations, user-intent fidelity, Explorer support, or independent human review are not established.
falsifier: A required behavior cannot be encoded without weakening it, hidden policy in fixture inputs, or a source-backed expected trace mismatch.
decision_rule: Report every case with qualified language result, support result and exact action/time matches. Full-expression labels require preserving frozen behavior; do not promote unresolved mismatches.
loss_contract: Wrong, missing or extra actions; wrong target, arguments, order or time; skipped, failed and partial cases remain in the denominator.
falsification_test: For relevant cases use interruptions, reset, startup, equality-time boundaries and non-triggering histories that distinguish plausible alternative policies.
